QuestInfo.name: Impeccable Disguise
QuestInfo.0: A new source of intel on the Black Wings... things are looking up!
QuestInfo.1: #p1401001# discovered that the Black Wings have been allowing someone near #m310000000# to sell a #bBlack Wings Hat#k under their noses. This might be the perfect opportunity for a little infiltration!
QuestInfo.2: If you put on a Black Wings Hat and act like you're better than everybody else, they shouldn't notice that you aren't actually one of them. Head down to #m310000000# and get your disguise.

0.0: I know I've told you this before, boss, but there are a lot of folks who look like Black Wings. They're not even a very big organization. \r\n#L0##bYou're right. I've seen a lot of those hats around town. I wonder if they're just using innocent people to make their numbers look bigger.#l\n#k
0.1: Or maybe someone in their organization is making a little money on the side. I did some looking and I found a place where you could actually buy #rBlack Wings Hats#k. \r\n#L0##bThey're using fashion trends for evil? Those scum!#l\n#k
0.2: Totally agree, boss! My source tells me there's a Black Wing member in #m310000000# doing the selling. \r\n#L0##bMaybe they really aren't paying their people enough. Either that, or they're just desperate for money.#l\n#k
0.3: I think it's closer to the former. The heads of the Black Wings don't seem to know about his little hat scheme. \r\n#L0##bWell, at least we know it's an authentic hat, and THAT means that we can make a perfect disguise!#l\n#k
0.4: Ding, ding! You put on one of their hats, we get all the intel we want.\r\n#L0##bI expected nothing less from you, #p1401001#. I am serious about that, if you do anything less, I will cut your pay in half.#l\n#k
0.5: You're all talk, boss. Put this thing on your noggin and get ready to start acting like a heel. Are you ready to go right away?

no.0: Fine, but I'm keeping the hat for now. I kinda like it.

1.0: Here's your hat. We didn't put any special super spy stuff in there. It's just a hat.

yes.0: There's only so much information you can buy off of people. You want more, you do your own dirty work.
